name: deal-card
description: Deal opportunity card with sector, status, metrics, NDA/CIM badges and access actions.
designIntent: Deal lists repeat the same card across trends, search and saved views. DealCard keeps the metrics and access state consistent and never implies NDA or CIM access without an explicit badge.

props.name: metrics
props.description: Three headline metrics such as revenue, EBITDA and margin.

examples.title: Deal opportunity
examples.code:
<DealCard
  title="Fleet services platform"
  sector="Transportation"
  location="South Atlantic"
  metrics={[
    { label: 'Revenue', value: '$20.4M' },
    { label: 'EBITDA', value: '$4.2M' },
    { label: 'Margin', value: '21%' },
  ]}
  ndaAvailable
  cimAvailable
  onRequestAccess={requestAccess}
/>
examples.description: A deal card with access badges and one action.

antiPatterns.title: Don't imply access with color
antiPatterns.explanation: NDA and CIM access are stated as text badges. Do not use color or a lock icon alone.

accessibility.implementation: Request access and Save are real buttons; Save exposes aria-pressed
Metrics render as a description list
accessibility.userRequirements: Use short labels and consistent units

compositionRules.relationship: Place cards in a responsive Grid
Pair a deal grid with LoadMore for paginated results
